what_it_is.prose: Mahindra Aerospace is the Mahindra Group's aerospace manufacturing arm, founded in 2010 (the Group entered aerospace in 2009 with the simultaneous acquisition of majority stakes in two Australian companies — GippsAero (GA8 Airvan manufacturer) and Aerostaff Australia). Mahindra Aerospace was the first Indian private firm to make smaller civil aircraft. Its subsidiary Mahindra Aerostructures Pvt Ltd operates a 25,000 sq.m metallic aerostructures fabrication facility near Bengaluru. Mahindra Aerostructures secured a major contract from Airbus Helicopters on 9 April 2025 to manufacture the main fuselage assembly of the H130 helicopter (shipped to Airbus Helicopters' final assembly line in Marignane, France); followed by the H125 fuselage contract announced 28 August 2025 (in addition to the H130 contract). On 27 October 2025, Mahindra Group formed a strategic alliance with Brazil's Embraer to introduce the C-390 Millennium military transport aircraft to India with local manufacturing, assembly, supply chain and engineering. Mahindra exited the GA8 Airvan programme in November 2023 when GippsAero co-founder George Morgan re-purchased the company. In August 2026, parent Mahindra Defence Systems Ltd incorporated Novavayu Aerospace (30 July 2026) as wholly-owned subsidiary for aircraft manufacturing.
